description: The file 'buildEdit.php' is a PHP script responsible for managing build operations in a test management web application. It handles creating, editing, updating, deleting, and state changes of build entries within test plans. It interacts with various modules like 'common.php', 'web_editor.php', and manages user permissions, form input parameters, and rendering of the GUI via Smarty templates.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP standard class, used for dynamic object creation to hold various data related to user operations, GUI states, and parameters.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request and session parameters into an object for downstream processing. Converts date strings to ISO format and fetches related test plan info.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with descriptive titles, custom fields, and execution status filters based on input arguments and build manager data.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the object with current build data for editing, including name, status flags, and date fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares default data to initialize a new build creation form, setting active and open flags, and default date.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of a build, checks for dependencies like execution counts, verifies permissions, and logs deletion events.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Responds to various actions by preparing the GUI with build data, custom fields, and template selection, then renders the Smarty template.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new build, performs validations, copies linked custom field values, sets closure date if needed, and optionally propagates to other test plans.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs update of an existing build, including validation, updating core attributes, linked custom fields, and logs activity.

methods.name: crossChecks
methods.description: Performs common validations for creation and update, such as duplicate name checking and release date validation.

methods.name: doCopyToTestPlans
methods.description: Copies a build to other test plans within the project, checking for duplicate build names.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies that the user has permissions to perform the intended operation within the project context.

methods.name: init_source_build_selector
methods.description: Initializes an HTML options list for selecting a source build when copying user assignments during build creation, including counts of assignments.
